articles.title: Welcome to Crystal
articles.summary: Your gateway to OG Fortnite is live. Jump in and explore the island!
articles.body: Crystal Launcher is now connected to the backend. Browse the shop, check the leaderboard, and join our Discord at discord.gg/crystalmp.

articles.title: Chapter 2 Season 4 Now Live
articles.summary: Build 15.30 is supported. Add your game folder from Home.
articles.body: Chapter 2 Season 4 is here on build 18.40. Use the Add Build card on Home to select your folder, then hit Play.

articles.title: Daily Item Shop Rotation
articles.summary: The item shop refreshes daily at 00:00 UTC. Check the Shop tab for new cosmetics.
articles.body: Purchase cosmetics directly from the launcher using your V-Bucks balance. Enable notifications to get alerted when the shop rotates.
